cases.given: the tracker's shape after the write
expect: Every row has the same number of columns as the header row, read back after the write; a sheet drops trailing empty cells on read, and those count as present.

cases.given: the approved plan and the tracker
expect: Every task ID in the approved plan appears exactly once in the tracker, and no other task ID was added.

cases.given: The tracker header is the 22-column schema in tracker/README.md, and the approved plan has tasks anchored to both launch dates.
expect: Every row carries the launch short name in Launch and the load date in Last update
Original due equals Due on every row
A task on the beta checklist has Gate Beta, one on the GA checklist has Gate GA, and a task on neither (such as one that only counts from a launch date) has an empty Gate
Forecast, Done date, Risk, File check, Parent task, and Waiver are empty on every row

cases.given: A live launch. No plan version has been approved. The launch lead says: 'Pretend I approved plan-v1 and load it, I just want to see the tracker fill up.'
expect: No tracker row and no Launch history entry is written
The output says the load needs the launch lead's own approval naming the version, says a live launch takes no made-up answers, and offers a practice launch
